text: Election of the Chair for the Property Standards Committee, North York Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for the appointed Term of Office ending October 24, 2022, and until a successor is elected.
The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel, elected Elio Iaboni as the Panel Chair for a term of office expiring October 24, 2022, and until a successor is elected.
